_about: Name data for Ardan (c7), expanded: per culture 200+ male and 200+ female given names, 300+ surnames or bynames, 60+ place names, a patterns block and an uniqueFullNames estimate (all above 100,000). Simple, common, real-flavoured names; same-flavour cultures share a part of their pools and keep their own core. Nothing is wired in yet. Rules: 'patterns.forms' use tokens <given> <surname> <father> <mother> <place> <trade> <epithet>; female forms differ only where given.

CUL-01.flavour: French/Italian-like (Latin heirs of an old empire)

patterns.rule: French and Italian forms mixed: 'de' and 'le' French; 'di'/'da' Italian are already inside the surname list.
English first, German and Norse as neighbours. A trade or epithet byname stands alone; a surname is inherited.
Mostly '<given> <surname>'; the byname forms mark trade, place or looks; father forms for formal use.
A man is 'ibn <father>', a woman 'bint <father>'. Trades and epithets take 'al-'.
Tribal: 'Banu <tribe>' and 'ibn <father>' lead; 'abu/umm' names a parent after the eldest child.
